representation: Each recorded measured left_tool0 pose expressed in the fixation frame at that same timestamp. All recorded timesteps within the previously approved pick windows; no thinning, recentering, or normalization. Position in meters followed by row-major 3x3 rotation. Fixation origin is zero; fixation Z is world-up.
optical_z_description: Normalized mean of each sample cyclopean camera optical +Z direction, expressed in its own upright fixation action frame; points from camera toward and beyond fixation. Not the action frame vertical Z axis.
world_frame_description: YAM bimanual URDF base frame. Same sample indices as poses; world = gaze_to_world @ fixation pose.
